evidence.decision: Chooses useful intents/entities and complete spoken responses independent of optional visual snippets.
evidence.artifact: Produces action/entity/parameter plus audible/visual response contracts.
evidence.transformation: See-this recipe output and indiscriminate promotion become named audio outcome and relevant indexed content.
evidence.verification: Fails essential snippet-only results, wrong contextual actions and dialogue requiring unseen context.
evidence.applicability: Checks schema availability and separates recognition/resolution/suggestion proof from source review.
evidence.handoffs: Action button handles hardware invocation; Writing concise follow-up and recovery.
evidence.distinctiveness: Entity annotation, relevant donation and object-specific spoken narrowing change contextual voice behavior.
